one_liner.value: AI SEO agent that plans, writes, and publishes content for you.
also_acceptable: SEO.AI is the AI SEO agent that creates ranking content, publishes it to your website, builds relevant backlinks, and keeps your visibility growing — 24/7.
one_liner.note: The meta description continues 'Grow organic traffic month by month - on autopilot, with … full control when needed.' (the reading tool cut the middle).

can_execute.note: Feature block 'Publish straight to your website', confirmed on a second read. Review is optional: 'You can choose between automatic publishing, saving as drafts, or reviewing directly in the platform.'

multi_agent.note: The site speaks of a single 'AI agent'; the 'SEO specialists' it mentions are people.

integrations.quote: WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, and many webshop systems such as Shopify, Magento, and more.

pricing.note: Single Site plan ('For one website in one language.'); Multi Site is $299 per month. 'Save 25% with annual payment. All prices exclude VAT.' free_tier is true because of a trial: 'Try 7-day trial'.

hq_location.note: Footer address. Elsewhere the homepage says 'Built by a team of SEO nerds in Copenhagen.' (Kongens Lyngby is the stated address; Copenhagen is not given as an address).

notes: Two-page marketing site (the 'Features' link points to the homepage); no about, contact or integrations page was linked.
